Actually if opponent just defected, we should defect regardless. - Use a forgiving TFT: if opponent defects, defect next round, but if opponent cooperates, cooperate next round. The trace simulates endgame policies (defect last round, last two rounds, last three rounds) against 12 opponents (TFT, slot0–slot11) and computes payoffs. It changes the parent by adding an explicit endgame rule: defect when n >= 98 (last two rounds), while keeping the parent's earlier cooperation/retaliation logic.
